title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Announcement of Board Approval Under Delegated Authority and Submission to OMB
action: On July 9, 2026, the Board published a notice in the Federal Register (91 FR 42441) requesting public comment for 60 days on the extension, with revision, of the FR 28. The Board proposed to revise the FR 28 by changing the collection platform of the FR 28a and FR 28s from Taleo to Workday, which will allow for three new submission methods in the Workday system (applying through LinkedIn, applying with resume parsing, and applying with previous application); the FR 28c, which is currently sent out via email, will also transition into Workday. The platform change will result in several data field changes for the FR 28a to (1) align with the configuration of Workday as the Board's new applicant tracking system (ATS) and (2) remove fields that are no longer necessary. By Fall 2028, the FR 28i will also be transitioned from ServiceNow to Workday. Before the transition of the FR 28i into Workday, one additional data field will be added in order to link applicants between ServiceNow and Workday; once the FR 28i is also in Workday, the data field will be removed. There were no proposed changes to the FR 28r as part of this clearance. The comment period for this notice expired on September 8, 2026. The Board did not receive any comments. The revisions will be implemented as proposed.
